title: Windows Service Misconfiguration (Unquoted Path / Weak Permissions)

references.name: MITRE ATT&CK - T1574.009 Path Interception by Unquoted Path
MITRE ATT&CK - T1574.010 Services File Permissions Weakness

description: Windows services are configured with weak permissions that allow a low-privileged user to modify the service binary, its configuration, or its executable path, or with unquoted service paths containing spaces that permit path interception. Because services typically run as SYSTEM, a local user can leverage these weaknesses to execute code with elevated privileges.
businessImpact: Critical --- service misconfigurations allow a standard user to escalate to SYSTEM and to establish persistence on the host.
remediation:
- Quote all service executable paths that contain spaces.
- Restrict permissions on service binaries, directories, and registry keys to administrators.
- Remove write/modify rights to service configuration from non-privileged users.
- Audit services with tooling and run services under least-privileged accounts.
